answer: The violet schedule is applied in sonnet and juniper publishes each instalment. A payout is split which means 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2068 identities would post 3784 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
